verdict.rationale: Bench's own AI Categorization Assistant accepts a plain-language description of a transaction's purpose and assigns a category in real time. That is a genuine but narrow natural-language input limited to one task. Messaging the human bookkeeping team is human support, not natural-language operation of the product, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: natural-language control beyond categorization (reports, account management, banking, tax tasks), a general conversational or agent interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Just describe the purpose of the transaction, and the AI Categorization Assistant identifies it in real-time.
